description: Analyze pasted raw email headers. Reports From / Return-Path / Reply-To / DKIM d= alignment (relaxed and strict), SPF / DKIM / DMARC / ARC verdicts as recorded by the receiving servers (Authentication-Results, ARC-*), the Received hop chain oldest first with per-hop delays and public IPs, and plain-English findings with severity and what each means or how to fix it. Makes no network or DNS calls and does not verify signatures. Header text is not stored. Read-only. Same engine as the MailAlign JSON API (POST /api/analyze).

headers.description:
The full raw header block of one email, e.g. "Received: from ...
Authentication-Results: ...
From: ...". A body after the first blank line is ignored.

include_raw.description: Also return the full /api/analyze JSON (all findings and hops) in structuredContent.raw.

name: analyze_headers

raw.description: Full /api/analyze response (only when include_raw is true)

title: Analyze email headers
